name: privacy.sexy
description: Enforce privacy & security best-practices on Windows, macOS and Linux, because privacy is sexy.
author: undergroundwires

scripts.check:quality: node node_modules/vue-tsc/bin/vue-tsc.js --noEmit && node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js . --max-warnings=0 && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.safe.config.ts && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.test:cy:run: start-server-and-test "vite build && vite preview --port 7070" http://localhost:7070 "cypress run --config baseUrl=http://localhost:7070"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:md && npm run lint:md:consistency && npm run lint:md:relative-urls && npm run lint:md:external-urls && npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:yaml && npm run lint:pylint

//devDependencies.@eslint/js: Native ESLint 10 recommended rules for flat config.
//devDependencies.@stylistic/eslint-plugin: Maintains TypeScript formatting rules removed from typescript-eslint.
//devDependencies.eslint-plugin-cypress: Native flat-config Cypress globals and recommended rules.
//devDependencies.eslint-plugin-import-x: Preserves the existing Airbnb import rule family and import ordering policy with ESLint 10 support.
//devDependencies.eslint-import-resolver-typescript: Resolves TypeScript path aliases for eslint-plugin-import-x.
//devDependencies.eslint-plugin-vuejs-accessibility: Preserves the existing Vue accessibility rule family and repository exceptions.
//devDependencies.typescript-eslint: Supported ESLint 10 TypeScript parser, plugin, and typed linting configuration.
//devDependencies.vue-eslint-parser: Required by eslint-plugin-vue to parse Vue single-file components.

//overrides.@modyfi/vite-plugin-yaml: Upstream pins vulnerable js-yaml 4.1.0; use the patched 4.x release without changing the loader API.
//overrides.global-agent: electron-builder's @electron/get 3.x pulls global-agent 3 -> roarr 2 -> sprintf-js (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c, no patched release); global-agent 4 drops roarr and keeps the bootstrap API.
//overrides.markdownlint-cli: Upstream pins js-yaml ~5.2 (GHSA-r3ph-w7gj-g6xm) and smol-toml ~1.7 (GHSA-r4xh-jqrq-34v2); use the patched releases of the same majors.
//overrides.micromark-extension-math: markdownlint only parses math syntax; katex 0.19 fixes GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7.

//optionalDependencies.dmg-license: Required by `electron-builder` for DMG builds on macOS, https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/issues/6489, https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/issues/6520
